_help: Models to follow in every email. 'match' lists words that must all be in the model name,
plus the storage size (e.g. 256gb, 1tb). 'target' (optional) is the price you would buy at:
the email marks the model when the cheapest shop is at or below it.
Words are matched in lower case; 'iphone 16 256gb' does not include the 16 Pro or Pro Max.
